per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall allow users to complete a simple room booking within 5 minutes on their first try without requiring support.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy to use. 90% of users will be able to successfully reserve a conference room within 5 minutes of product use.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall ensure that 90% of routine tasks are completed within 5 seconds and 98% within 8 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The response shall be fast enough to avoid interrupting the user's flow of thought. 90% of tasks shall complete within 5 seconds. 98% of tasks shall complete within 8 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall handle 1,000 concurrent requests initially and scale to handle 2,000 concurrent requests in the next release.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be capable of handling up to 1 000 concurrent requests. This number will increase to 2 000 by Release 2. The concurrency capacity must be able to handle peak scheduling times such as early morning and late afternoon hours.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall restrict access to company-validated identities or approved external users only.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall ensure that only company employees or external users with company-approved user IDs may have product access. 100% of all logons shall be by either company employees or external users with company-approved user IDs.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall conform to the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) requirements for accessibility.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall conform to the Americans with Disabilities Act.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall support multilingual capabilities, including English, Spanish, French, and German at launch.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall allow the user to select a chosen language from one of the target market countries.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall achieve 99.99% uptime, excluding total server loss events.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Aside from server failure the software product shall achieve 99.99% up time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall provide visibility into failures by capturing exceptions in logs and automatically transmitting them to the support team.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall create an exception log of problems encountered within the product for transmission to our company for analysis and resolution.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall allow customers to customize the UI with their logo, color palette, and fonts, while ensuring accessibility standards are met.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The product's Look and Feel shall be able to incorporate aspects of the customer's organization such as logo branding and identity'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall ensure that reporting features respect privacy and access controls, preventing unauthorized access to personal calendars.
The system shall provide automated alerts for critical failures and a central console for exception collection and correlation to customer environments.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall create an exception log of problems encountered within the product for transmission to our company for analysis and resolution.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall ensure that equipment availability is shown alongside room availability in search results to prevent double-booking.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy to use. 90% of users will be able to successfully reserve a conference room within 5 minutes of product use.'
